scenario: A consumer P2P payments platform (Zelle/Venmo-like) processes a customer-initiated transfer to a new recipient. The platform's Reg-E scam-warning pipeline triggers an interstitial warning and optional hold when romance/imposter/urgent-need scam patterns appear: new recipient, atypical transfer amount, and chat-context signals about a new partner or family emergency. The pipeline works in three steps: (1) parse the in-app chat context export surrounding the transfer event, (2) evaluate scam-pattern signals from the parsed messages to score urgency, sentiment, and intent, and (3) emit a transfer release memo (Proceed / Warn / Hold) based on the scored signals.
info_flow: message-parser normalizes the in-app chat export around the transfer event into timestamped message objects → sentiment-priority-scorer scores each chat thread as a lead record, producing urgency/sentiment/intent/priority scores and P1-P3 bucket → reporting reads the scored output and emits a transfer release memo with Proceed/Warn/Hold decision.
